title: Suite catalogue index
description: The signed catalogue index a host verifies before it lists a pack (S12.2). Version 2 adds the ring, the contract version, the host floor and the manifest signature to each entry (S12.9). `@suite/pack` parses this shape and reads a version 1 index as contract 1.
$comment: Capabilities resolve to the pack manifest's closed vocabulary in manifest.schema.json, so a new capability is added once. `entries` order is id, then version, then publisher; the canonical bytes sort it that way.

previous.description: The digest of the index this one replaces. Sequence 1 omits it; every later index names its predecessor.

threshold.description: How many distinct pinned operator signatures must verify. It is inside the signed bytes, so it cannot be lowered without them.

timestamp.description: An ISO 8601 instant with a zone.

archive.description: Where the `.suitepack` is and what it hashes to. The only place a v2 entry carries these facts.

url.$comment: Absolute HTTPS, no credentials, no fragment. The pattern is the shape; the parser is the enforcement point.

entry.description: One signed pack version. `version`, `ring`, `contractVersion` and `minHost` equal the manifest's effective values: an absent `ring` is `stable`, and a manifest that carries `minimumHostVersion` matches a `minHost` entry (S12.9).

ring.description: The pack's own stability, copied from the manifest. Absent in the manifest means `stable`. A ring is not a host channel.

contractVersion.description: The pack contract the manifest declares. Required: the manifest requires it, so a generated entry always carries it, and an entry without it is refused. An index written before S12.9 (version 1) has no such field and is read as contract 1.

minHost.description: The host floor, copied from the manifest's effective floor. Omitted when the manifest declares none.

signature.description: The pack manifest's Ed25519 signature, standard base64, so the host can compare the entry with the manifest it unpacked (S12.7).

platforms.description: The host kinds the manifest declared, so a row can judge platform fit before download.

signature.description: One operator's Ed25519 signature over the canonical index bytes. A publisher key never verifies an index.
